text:
marie_support: FYI ticket from Eric (acct acct_0X9bK). He finished signup, verified email, added a card via Apple Pay, 3DS completed, but no onboarding credits landed. Can payments/fraud look?
marie_support: Quick summary: email verify at 23:12:09 UTC, pm_tokenized at 23:12:14, 3DS CALLBACK at 23:12:15 -> webhooks show token callback before our internal email-provision event finished processing.
customer_eric: Hi—yes I verified email and completed Apple Pay. Dashboard shows usage 0 and credits 0. I was expecting the 100 free tokens promo.
sam_payments: thanks @marie_support. Dropping into logs now. Can you paste the signup_id or email?
marie_support: email eric@acme.tools, signup_id sg_9f7a2, region detected FR (from PM BIN) but IP geolocate initially CA then FR after CDN reroute — possible region flip.
sam_payments: running quick lookup...
sam_payments: (logs) autogrant flow: event_order: [pm_tokenized:2432109734, 3ds:2432109735, email_verified:2432109729] -> looks like email_verified is earlier in our DB? that's odd. Need raw webhook timings.
marie_support: I pulled webhook payloads attached in ticket; the email verification webhook shows delivered at 23:12:09 but our user-provision consumer shows processed at 23:12:20. So external order vs internal processing differ.
lina_eng: @sam_payments can you paste the account row? I'll check autogrant gating logic.
sam_payments: account row: `account_id: acct_0X9bK, email: eric@acme.tools, pm_id: pm_apple_342, country: FR, autogrant_status: skipped, autogrant_reason: probe_failed`
jordan_fraud: probe_failed = our business gate probe that runs a few checks before auto-grant. It sets skipped when PM/BIN mismatch or transient probe can't be completed. Did the probe timeout?
sam_payments: probe logs: BIN country FR, IP geolookup initially CA at request then FR on PM callback -> probe timed out waiting for consistent region.
marie_support: customer flow: they used a VPN in onboarding then removed it before finishing 3DS. CDN routed callbacks differently.
sam_payments: ok reproducer steps for us: 1) start signup from IP CA 2) initiate Apple Pay 3) network switch so PM callback arrives with FR bin 4) email verify happens, but the provisioning consumer processed it after the payment probe timed out -> autogrant skipped.
lina_eng: Thanks. Root cause seems to be a race between payment probe and user-provision consumer; autogrant gate requires probe completed and provision processed within 10s window. If either side lags, we skip and create manual review.
jordan_fraud: Is the probe aggressively strict for BIN/IP mismatch? Could relax or fallback to deferred check.
sam_payments: For immediate fix we can manual-grant credits and ticket an infra fix. I'll apply the grant now. @ops_bot can you run the grant script?
ops_bot: /grant_onboarding acct_0X9bK amount=100 reason="manual grant after autogrant race" requested_by=sam_payments
ops_bot: Grant queued, running...
ops_bot: Grant applied successfully. New balance: 100 credits.
customer_eric: I see the 100 credits now, thank you!
marie_support: great. Marking customer resolved.
lina_eng: Created GH issue redwood/autogrant#542 to extend autogrant window to 30s and add eventual consistency path: if email provision arrives within 5m, kick deferred autogrant attempt. Assigning to eng-infra.
jordan_fraud: Also adding a telemetry metric for probe timeouts and BIN/IP flip counts.
sam_payments: Follow-ups: 1) manual grant done, 2) refunds not needed, 3) infra ticket created, 4) notify CX to close ticket.
marie_support: I'll message the customer with root-cause and link to ticket. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
